name: oracle-support-sr
description: Manage OCI support requests and readable updates through the official OCI CLI and Python SDK.

interface.shortDescription: SRs de OCI por CLI y SDK
interface.longDescription: Create, read, update, attach evidence and close selected OCI SRs from Codex or Claude Code. Customer credentials remain local; no background monitor is included.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use oracle-support-sr to inspect my OCI support requests and prepare the next evidence-based action.
